decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The demolition of the existing rear extension and erection of single storey rear extension and roof extension incorporating rear and side dormer window to dwellinghouse by reason of design, size, materials and appearance is considered to comply with policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Residential Extensions) of Council Unitary Development Plan, 2003 as well as Section 5 and 8 (Roof Extensions; Conservation Areas) of Council's Residential Extension Guidelines, 2002 also Sections 7 and 9 (Conservation Areas, Form and Design) of Council's SPG, 1997.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of existing rear extension and erection of single storey rear extension and roof extension incorporating rear and side dormer window to dwellinghouse.
